chapters.title: The Man They Sent
chapters.synopsis: At Forward Base Lantern, Major Calder Rhys prepares to guard a scientist he has already decided to dislike, while a dead frequency repeats a warning.

chapters.title: The Initial
chapters.synopsis: Dr. Ivo Maren flies toward a man he has not seen in fourteen years and chooses, with his whole composure, to say nothing.

chapters.title: Asset Orchid
chapters.synopsis: The briefing should be simple. The scientist is not fragile, not impressed, and familiar in a way Calder cannot name.

chapters.title: People You Mean to Bring Back
chapters.synopsis: Captain Nia Okonkwo counts the living on the river staging and decides the ghost signal is not a bad radio.

chapters.title: Scientifically Acceptable
chapters.synopsis: Ivo crosses a perimeter because the moths do, and Calder learns that curiosity is not the same thing as stupidity.

chapters.title: What the Rapids Didn't Do
chapters.synopsis: Survey Lantern's camp contradicts its obituary. Lieutenant Sable Venn needs a biologist she does not want to trust.

chapters.title: Look at Its Movement
chapters.synopsis: Glass kites hit at dusk. Ivo's eye saves the shot. Calder's hands save Ivo. Respect arrives disguised as anger.

chapters.title: Not on the Chart
chapters.synopsis: The medic treats the wounded, watches a marriage work under orders, and tells Calder the truth about fear that stays quiet.

chapters.title: The First Stones
chapters.synopsis: The causeway of Qalen-Sar rises out of the roots. Ivo almost says a name. The expedition enters the city.
